reviews.title: A 4K Beast! The perfect sweet spot for Blackwell
reviews.comment: I upgraded to the 5070 Ti and the performance jump is massive. This card feels much closer to a 5080 than a 5060 Ti. With the 256-bit bus and 16GB of GDDR7, I’m finally able to play titles like Resident Evil 4 Remake and Cyberpunk at 4K with Path Tracing enabled and still hit triple-digit frame rates. It stays incredibly cool (rarely hits 65°C under load) and the 12V-2x6 power connection makes for a much cleaner build. If you want high-end performance without the $1,000+ price tag of the top-tier cards, this is the one to get.
